QC-HOME-002 —
Promotional Banners / Ad Slots
FRONTEND — Visitor Display
User Story ID
QC-HOME-002 | US001 |
REF: FR-004
Title
Promotional Banners — Visitor Display
As a
public website visitor
I want
to see promotional banner/advertisement slots displayed on
the Home Page
So that
I can discover and access relevant Qatar Chamber
promotions, events, and announcements
Preconditions:
- At least one promotional banner slot is published and
active in the CMS.
Frontend Workflow:
1. Visitor scrolls the Home Page to the promotional banners
section.
2. One or more promotional banner images display in a slider or
grid layout.
3. Visitor clicks a banner — browser navigates to the
configured redirect URL (same tab or new tab as configured).
4. If multiple banners are active, the section auto-cycles or
allows manual navigation.
5. The section is fully responsive on all screen sizes.
Given the
visitor views the Home Page
When the
promotional banners section renders
Then
- The system shall display only published and active
promotional banner slots.
- Each banner shall display the configured image with
appropriate alt text.
- Clicking a banner shall navigate to the configured
redirect URL (new tab if configured, same tab otherwise).
- Banners with a configured date range shall only display
within their start/end dates.
- The section shall be fully responsive on all screen
sizes.
Edge Case Scenarios:
- If no active banner is published, the promotional
banner section shall not render on the Home Page.
- If a banner image fails to load, the section shall hide
that banner gracefully.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the redirect URL for a banner is broken or the page
is unpublished, clicking the banner shall show a 404 page.
Post Condition:
- Active promotional banners are visible on the Home Page
and all redirect links are functional.
BACKEND — Admin CMS
Management
User Story ID
QC-HOME-002 | US002 | REF:
FR-004
Title
Promotional Banners — CMS Management
As a
authorized admin user (Site Content Editor)
I want
to manage the promotional banner/advertisement slots on
the Home Page from the CMS
So that
active and relevant promotional content is shown to
visitors in the banner slot area
Preconditions:
- Admin user has the appropriate permissions to manage
Home Page content in Liferay CMS.
Administrator Workflow:
1. Site Content Editor logs into Liferay CMS.
2. Navigates to Home Page → Promotional Banners / Ad Slots
Management.
3. Clicks Add Banner to create a new promotional banner
entry.
4. Uploads the banner image (bilingual if required) and
enters bilingual alt text.
5. Enters the redirect URL and configures Open in New Tab
toggle.
6. Sets display order, active status, and optional start/end
display dates.
7. Saves as draft and publishes the banner slot.
8. System saves and displays a Liferay generic success toast
message.
9. Published banner appears in the promotional section after
cache refresh.
Given the admin
opens Promotional Banners management in the CMS
When the admin
creates, edits, activates, or deactivates a banner
Then
- The system shall allow the admin to add, edit,
enable/disable, and delete promotional banner slots.
- Each slot shall support: banner image (bilingual),
bilingual alt text, redirect URL, open in new tab toggle, display order, active
status, optional start/end dates.
- The system shall allow draft, submit for review,
publish, and unpublish actions.
- Only active and published banners within their
scheduled date range shall appear on the frontend.
- The system shall display a Liferay generic success
toast message after each successful action.
Negative Scenarios:
- If the banner image is not uploaded: "Banner Image
is required." صورة البانر مطلوبة.
- If the redirect URL is invalid: "Please enter a
valid URL." يرجى إدخال رابط صالح.
- If the admin lacks permission: "Access Denied. You
do not have permission to perform this action." تم رفض الوصول. ليس لديك صلاحية
لتنفيذ هذا الإجراء.
Post Condition:
- Active promotional banners are published and displayed
on the Home Page.
